system.longDesc: You are a skilled and capable leader.

degree0.desc: Your presence inspires allies. If you take a major action to offer guidance, your allies gain a +1 bonus to Willpower (Courage) and Willpower (Morale) tests for the rest of the encounter. You can do this once per encounter.

degree1.desc: Your allies follow your lead. Any NPCs or PCs you lead gain a +1 bonus when rolling for initiative.

degree2.desc: When you stand firm, your allies stand with you. When you lead NPCs or PCs in an encounter, they do not have to make a Willpower (Morale) test until more than two-thirds of your side’s combatants are out of the fight (dead or incapacitated). PCs also gain a +2 to Willpower (Courage) tests. If you leave the fight or are taken out, this benefit is lost.
